list: Official 55-trophy list as published by PlayStation, via Exophase and PSNProfiles (2026-11-18): 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies: official names, descriptions and grades.
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies: grades and PSN progress counts.
Leonida Legend guide notes: our own advice drawn from the official descriptions; not yet verified in-game.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is no separate task. Work through the roadmap stages in order and it arrives last, after 100% completion.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game, so this unlocks naturally in the opening hour and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Play through every mission in Chapter 1. Chapter trophies unlock at the chapter's final cutscene, so keep following the story markers until the chapter closes.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Play through every mission in Chapter 2 to its end. Like the other chapter trophies, it unlocks automatically when the chapter's last mission is done.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Play through every mission in Chapter 3. The trophy lands at the chapter's closing mission, so there is nothing extra to hunt for.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Play through every mission in Chapter 4. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, and it unlocks at the chapter's end.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. It is the only gold trophy tied to the story, and it unlocks at the end of the campaign, whatever ending path the story takes.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: MISSABLE — complete the mission Breakfast Run on your first playthrough. Mission-specific story trophies like this one are the ones to watch: finish the mission when it appears, and if the game offers mission replay, use it to pick up any you passed by.
trophies.name: Trust
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: MISSABLE — complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are one-shot story beats, so take the mission when it is offered and see it through to the getaway.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: MISSABLE — complete the mission Child's Play. Finish it when the story brings it up; a missed mission trophy means a replay or a second playthrough.
trophies.name: Family Matters
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: MISSABLE — complete the mission Headliners. Treat every named story mission as a one-time chance and clear it the first time it is offered.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: MISSABLE — complete the mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. Airport missions tend to lock after the story moves on, so do it when it appears.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: MISSABLE — complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. It is a named operation in the story, so finish it on your first run through the campaign.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion, the game's own checklist: story, stranger strands, activities, challenges and collectibles. It is the last gold before the platinum, so treat this tracker as the 100% list and clear every category.
trophies.name: A Long Road
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, drifts and airtime all count toward the tally. It builds up across free roam, so stunt whenever you travel instead of driving straight, and watch the counter climb.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once — racing, fishing, shooting range, drone races, arcade, bowling, meditation, hunting and stunts. Open each activity's venue at least once; one try each is enough, no wins needed.
trophies.name: Master of None
sources: PSNProfiles — PSN progress count (9 activity types)
Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each range has its own drills, so learn the scoring — accuracy beats speed — and replay any drill you silver until the gold medal lands.
trophies.name: The Shootist
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Drone races are short, so learn each course's gates, cut corners where the gates allow, and tick locations off one by one.
trophies.name: Top Fun
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across Leonida — street, off-road and water races all count, but each race only counts once. Enter new events instead of replaying the same one.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at the fishing spots, take his challenge, and out-fish him — steady reeling and watching the line tension matter more than rushing.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game at any arcade in Leonida. Pick the cabinet you like, play it to its end, and the trophy pops on completion — no high score needed.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — finish Andy's mission strand to its final mission. Character strands end when their story does, so keep taking Andy's missions whenever they appear and see the last one through.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — finish Kenton's mission strand to its final mission. Do not leave a character's missions sitting; strands close out, and the finale only comes if you played the strand through.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — finish Billy's mission strand to its final mission. Work through Billy's jobs in order and the finale unlocks at the end of the strand.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers appear as ? markers on the map — talk to them, follow their multi-mission stories to the end, and count 8 completed strands.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — finish Randy's mission strand to its final mission. Like the other character finales, it only comes after playing Randy's whole strand.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — finish Tyrone's mission strand to its final mission. Clear Tyrone's jobs as they appear and the strand's finale closes the set.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are quiet scenic points around the map — visit each, sit through the meditation, and tick them off as you explore.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Take Bret's hunting job, track the animal it names — unique animals are one-of-a-kind spawns, so follow the clues rather than hunting at random.
trophies.name: Fair Game
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida in shops, hideouts and mission spots — collect full sets and the trophy counts completed sets, not single cards.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK is the in-game social app — check in at 100 different spots around Leonida and the count climbs one per new location.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Finish 50 challenges. Challenges cover driving, combat, exploration and more, and they stack up naturally across a full playthrough — check the challenges menu and clear the easy ones first.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Break line of sight, switch vehicles, and hide until the stars clear — the trophy needs the escape with your partner, not just losing the heat alone.
trophies.name: Hot Together
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner and keep your wanted level the whole way. Plan a route of three close shops, rob each fast, and stay out of sight between them so the heat never drops.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — drive or ride a new model and it counts. Variety is the trick: try different classes, from scooters to trucks to boats, and the counter climbs with each new find.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus. Wait for a crowded firefight, trigger Combat Focus, and chain five takedowns before it ends — a busy shootout is the place to try.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport: get airside and leave in a plane outside the scheduled flights. Airport access is story-gated, so try it while the airport is open to you.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Face down Rhino tanks. Rhinos show up at high wanted levels and in military encounters — survive the heat, use heavy weapons or cover, and the trophy pops for tangling with them.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being seen. Case the store first, go in quiet, grab the goods and slip out before anyone raises the alarm — detection fails the attempt, so patience beats speed.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Vault jobs need planning — a getaway vehicle, a route out, and a cool-down after — and each clean escape counts toward the five.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, crack it open, take the cash and break away before backup arrives — one clean job is all it takes.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you visit each named area — drive the highways, take the back roads, and check the map for the last grey patches.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation of each of the 9 gangs. Every gang runs its own rackets around Leonida — hit a different gang's operation each time until all nine are ticked off.
trophies.name: Pest Control
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a beachfront bar on Ocean Drive, order a drink, and enjoy the view — a quiet moment trophy, best done while exploring Vice City.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. This is a set-piece moment tied to a showroom scene, so when the story puts you in a showroom, drive out through the glass instead of the door.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley. Follow through on your shots — a full game at that alley is what counts, so finish the game rather than walking out mid-frame.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Build a partnership with mass appeal. This one tracks your partner content — keep playing missions and activities together and the partnership's appeal grows until it pops.
trophies.name: Personal Best
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: PSN tracks this one to a count of 500 choices made. Choices appear all through the story and side content, so keep choosing — dialogue picks, mission approaches and side decisions all feed the count.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try. Fail something, then pass it on the retry — a failed mission or activity that you clear the second time around is the trigger, so do not be afraid to retry.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Witness something strange. Leonida is full of random events and odd encounters — keep your eyes open while roaming and a bizarre moment will find you.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by — drive past and strike with a melee weapon from the vehicle. A slow pass down a busy street gives you the cleanest shot.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from heists and robberies — hand them to your laundering contacts over time and the total climbs to a quarter of a million.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida. Clothes, weapons, food and vehicles all count — big purchases like cars move the total fastest, and it adds up across the whole playthrough.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Garages go on sale around Leonida as you progress — save up, buy each one, and the trophy pops on the eighth.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles you like, open the app, and register each one — ten different registrations complete the set.
trophies.name: On the Spot
sources: Leonida Legend — our own advice from the official description
